description: Timestamp of air quality observation formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Sequential across 5 years (2021-2025).
Name of the Indian municipal city / monitoring zone (50 major cities across North, South, East, West, and Central India).
Particulate Matter with aerodynamic diameter <= 2.5 micrometres, measured in ug/m3. Primary driver of National AQI.
Particulate Matter with aerodynamic diameter <= 10 micrometres, measured in ug/m3 (coarse inhalable dust and exhaust particles).
Nitrogen Dioxide concentration measured in parts per billion (ppb). Key indicator of vehicular traffic and diesel emissions.
Sulphur Dioxide concentration measured in parts per billion (ppb). Primarily originates from thermal power generation and refining.
Carbon Monoxide concentration measured in parts per million (ppm). Emitted from incomplete combustion in engines and biomass.
Ground-level Tropospheric Ozone concentration in parts per billion (ppb). Formed by photochemical reactions between NOx and VOCs.
Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) National Air Quality Index (0-500 scale): 0-50 Good, 51-100 Satisfactory, 101-200 Moderate, 201-300 Poor, 301-400 Very Poor, 401-500 Severe.
Ambient surface air temperature measured in degrees Celsius (°C).
Relative atmospheric humidity expressed as a percentage (%).
